alternatives_and_negative_results: An IID-CUT binomial interval or an unqualified exchangeability assumption is not justified for this processed radar chain.
applicability: Statistical qualification of a radar map where within-map CUT dependence is present and CPI seeds are independently generated.
assessed_root_cause: The statistical dependence structure is at the CPI output-vector level, not an IID population of individual CUTs.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Use per-CPI alarm counts/fractions as the statistical unit and a method whose theorem matches that sampling structure.
generalizable_lesson: For correlated spatial outputs, define the independent experimental unit before calculating uncertainty; never substitute CUT count for independent-trial count.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: Treating every valid CUT as an independent Bernoulli observation would inflate the effective sample size.
non_applicability: Does not prove physical independence of hardware CPI, clutter transfer, or general Pd/Pfa outside the approved noise-only Python reference.
observable_consequence: The final Pfa method uses 20,000 CPI-level alarm fractions; the approved bound is computed over independent CPI observations while allowing arbitrary within-CPI CUT correlation.
observed_problem: The 2D range-Doppler CUTs share pulse-compression, MTI and FFT processing and cannot be presumed mutually independent.
repeatable_validation: Check the fixed N=20,000 result, 2,782 valid CUTs/CPI, CPI-level EB upper bound 0.0014491445035750084 <= 0.0015 and independent Welford result.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Preserve the approved S02 v1.2 contract, fixed sample size, seed separation, alpha and no-optional-stopping rule.
title: Use whole CPI observations for correlated range-Doppler CUT statistics
